facts.fact: The Fonds de développement du service universel (FDSU) was created by law no. 20/17 of 5 November 2020 and is funded by telecom operators' levy on turnover plus government subsidies, PPPs and international funding, but Internet Society RDC's secretary general said in February 2025 that it was still not available, and no collection or project payment is stated.
facts.system: Fonds de développement du service universel (FDSU)

note: Only the fund's creation by law is dated; no collection or spending is stated and the fund is described as not yet operational.
